verdict.rationale: Cursor docs mention 'always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix your software' (cursor-docs-9), directly matching the automation-on-events story, and 'rules' are referenced as a configurable feature (cursor-docs-5). However, this is a single thin vendor mention with no detail on how rules/triggers are authored, no independent/hands-on corroboration, and no documentation of event types or reliability. Missing for 10: detailed docs on rule syntax/trigger types, independent verification that scheduled/triggered agents work reliably, and community confirmation of this specific feature in practice.
